title: A quasi-compact scheme covered by affine nonvanishing loci of globally generated invertible sheaves carries an ample invertible sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs an ample invertible sheaf on a quasi-compact scheme X from the local existence of globally generated pairs (L, s) with x in X_s and X_s affine. The proof chooses finitely many such pairs covering X by quasi-compactness, then for each i chooses finitely many sections t_{i,j} of L_i whose nonvanishing loci cover X, and forms the tensor product L of the L_i together with the product sections tau_J = t_{1,j_1} tensor ... tensor t_{n,j_n} (proof lines 7903-7919). It then invokes the affinity criterion for intersections of nonvanishing loci to see that X_{tau_J} is affine whenever one index j_i is zero, checks that these opens cover X, and concludes ampleness by the definition (proof lines 7920-7923). H2: the two-step finite covering argument and the verification of the ampleness criterion are the substance.
